units.source_text: 到了封棋，对弈者离开棋盘之前，要计算当天的子数，又要查对用时。

en.t: When it came time to seal the move, before the players left the board, they had to count the number of moves made that day and also check the time used.

units.source_text: 这种时候，名人实在难以理解。

en.t: At times like this, the Master was truly hard to understand.
